# o11y_alert_contact (Resource)

A verified human email contact for reusable alert notification groups. Verification tokens are never stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "o11y_alert_contact" "primary" {
  contact_key          = "primary-oncall"
  display_name         = "Primary on-call"
  email                = "oncall@example.com"
  request_verification = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contact_key` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `email` (String)

### Optional

- `request_verification` (Boolean) Send a verification email for each new contact generation. Confirmation remains an out-of-band user action.

### Read-Only

- `generation` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `revision` (Number)
- `status` (String)
